scope: Official capability semantics read via Context7 and web; no actual account/provider actions
observations: getSchedule: delegated personal account unsupported; calendarView supports personal delegated read
Event create: attendee invitations are sent by provider; transactionId assists create retry deduplication
Online provider capabilities are calendar-specific; enabled meeting provider cannot simply be switched
Event updates: preserve meeting data if changing body; changeKey existence alone is not a tested precondition contract
Cancel: organizer-only, item moved to Deleted Items, bodyless 202; not application reconciliation proof
Immutable event IDs are opt-in, case-sensitive and stable within a mailbox, with documented exceptions
PostgreSQL exclusion constraints are local overlap candidates, not atomic external-calendar locks
limits: No capability, permission, subscription or SDK selected
Actual MA-006 tests and exact wire/account bindings remain required
